title: BioIVT: months survived reads the date of death from Death Details
description: Adds a hidden lookup of the date of death from the Death Details form (common event) beside 'Number of months survived'. If the lookup returns nothing the calculation uses the follow-up data date.
rationale: Supports calc_months_survived. Fail-safe: no death record means survival so far.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
